page: Body Limit Middleware for restricting request body file size. Limits incoming request payload. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {bodyLimit} from 'hono/body-limit'. Checks Content-Length header first if present, otherwise reads stream. Returns 413 status code when size exceeded. Default maxSize: 100 * 1024 (100KB). Options: maxSize (required, number in bytes), onError (optional, (c: Context) => response function for size exceeded). Access body with c.req.parseBody(). Type checking: body['file'] instanceof File. Bun compatibility: Bun.serve default limit 128MiB. If Hono maxSize > Bun limit, Bun rejects with 413 before Hono receives request and onError won't be called. Bun configuration: maxRequestBodySize parameter in Bun.serve() or export default config object. Example value: 1024 * 1024 * 200 (200MB). Use cases: file uploads, preventing DoS, storage protection. HTTP status: 413 Payload Too Large. Questions: How to limit request body size? What's the default size? How to handle size exceeded? Does it work with Bun? What size can Bun handle? How to set Bun body limit? Can I customize error handling?

Body Limit usage pattern and example. app.post('/upload', bodyLimit({...}), handler). Options: maxSize (50 * 1024 for 50KB, required), onError ((c) => handler function for exceeding limit). onError example returns c.text('overflow :(', 413) with HTTP 413 status. Access parsed body: const body = await c.req.parseBody(). Type checking file: body['file'] instanceof File. Access file size: body['file'].size via File object. Success response: c.text('pass :)'). Body Limit options specification. Required: maxSize (number, bytes, default 100 * 1024 = 100KB). Optional: onError (OnError function type, invoked when maxSize exceeded). Questions: What sizes can I set? What's the default? How to customize errors? Can I log overflows?

Bun runtime special considerations for large body limits. Bun.serve() default maxRequestBodySize: 128MiB. If Hono bodyLimit maxSize > 128MiB, Bun rejects request with 413 before reaching Hono application. Consequence: onError handler never called because connection terminates at Bun level. Solution: Configure Bun maxRequestBodySize explicitly. Two configuration patterns: 1) export default {port: env['PORT'] || 3000, fetch: app.fetch, maxRequestBodySize: 1024 * 1024 * 200}, 2) Bun.serve({fetch(req, server), maxRequestBodySize: 1024 * 1024 * 200}). Example value: 1024 * 1024 * 200 for 200MB limit. Must set Bun limit >= Hono limit. Warning: Bun limit applies before Hono middleware. Questions: What's Bun's default body limit?
